theorem: Universal Paley-Jacobsthal Graph State Theorem over Z for n = 13, 14, 17, 18
summary: A single unweighted {0, 1} Paley / Bordered-Paley graph at n = 13, 14, 17, 18 simultaneously defines an exact pure AME(n, D) graph state over every finite field F_q and modular ring Z/DZ coprime to the small set of prime divisors of its integer cut minors.

graphs: P_13: unweighted 6-regular Paley-13 circulant on Z_13 with quadratic-residue step vector a = (1, 0, 1, 1, 0, 0)
P_14: unweighted 7-regular Bordered Paley-14 graph obtained by bordering P_13 with an apex vertex infinity connected to all 13 ring vertices with weight 1
n_13_and_14.universal_ame_dimensions: Every prime power q and every composite integer D with gcd(D, 6) = 1 (D = 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19, 23, 25, 35, ...)

n_17.graph: P_17: unweighted 8-regular Paley-17 circulant on Z_17 with quadratic-residue step vector a = (1, 1, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1)
n_17.universal_ame_dimensions: Every prime power q and every composite integer D with gcd(D, 6) = 1 (D = 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19, 23, 25, 35, ...)

graphs: P_18: unweighted 9-regular Bordered Paley-18 graph obtained by bordering P_17 with an apex vertex infinity connected to all 17 ring vertices with weight 1
C_18: Jacobsthal-18 symmetric conference matrix in {0, +1, -1}^{18x18} (C_18^2 = 17 I_18)
n_18.universal_ame_dimensions_P18: Every prime power q and composite integer D with gcd(D, 1482) = 1 (D = 5, 7, 11, 17, 23, 25, 29, 31, 35, ...)
